legal.privacySubtitle: किसान मित्र प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर दी गई जानकारी को कैसे संभाला जाता है।

legal.privacyInformationDesc: Kisaan Mitra may collect information such as name, phone number, email address, crop details, vehicle information and booking details when you use the platform.
legal.privacyUsageDesc: Information may be used to create accounts, process bookings, generate digital tokens, manage mandi workflows and provide platform-related services.
legal.privacyProtectionDesc: Appropriate technical and organizational measures should be used to protect account and booking information from unauthorized access or misuse.
legal.privacyThirdPartyDesc: The platform may integrate with external services where required for specific functionality. Their respective terms may also apply.
legal.privacyContactDesc: Questions regarding privacy can be submitted through the Contact page.
legal.termsPlatformDesc: Users should provide accurate information and use Kisaan Mitra only for legitimate mandi-related activities.
legal.termsAccountDesc: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and for activity carried out through their account.
legal.termsBookingDesc: Slot availability, booking information and mandi operations may change. Users should review the information shown on the platform before relying on it for travel or operational planning.
legal.termsAcceptableDesc: Users should not attempt to misuse, disrupt, reverse engineer or gain unauthorized access to the platform or another user's account.
legal.termsChangesDesc: These terms may be updated as the Kisaan Mitra platform evolves.
